articles.title: Hackers Used Meta’s AI Support Bot to Seize Instagram Accounts
articles.summary: Microsoft drops a record-breaking 200 patches in one Patch Tuesday, with nearly three dozen critical fixes. When even Redmond's security team needs a vacation after one release cycle, you know the digital apocalypse is upon us.

articles.title: Netherlands Seizes 800 Servers, Arrests 2 for Aiding Cyberattacks
articles.summary: Meta's AI chatbot gets social engineered into handing over Obama's and Space Force chief's Instagram accounts to Iranian hackers. Even the machines are falling for basic social engineering now—what a time to be alive.

articles.title: Enshittification Merch That Actually Fights Enshittification
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally publishes AWS GovCloud keys and agency secrets on public GitHub, prompting Congressional fury. Nothing says 'cybersecurity leadership' like leaving your crown jewels in a public repo.

articles.title: Nightmare-Eclipse Drops Yet Another Microsoft Exploit, RoguePlanet
articles.summary: Meta quietly removes facial recognition code from smart glasses app after public outcry and damning WIRED exposé. Victory achieved through the ancient art of 'naming and shaming'—still the most effective bug bounty program.

articles.title: The Invisible Battlefield: How Cyber War Is Reshaping Everyday Life
articles.summary: Nightmare-Eclipse drops another Windows Defender exploit called RoguePlanet, continuing their personal war against Microsoft. When researchers go rogue, they really commit to the bit.

articles.title: Top Pentagon Official Admits Boat Strike May Have Killed Victims of Human Trafficking
articles.summary: Bipartisan momentum builds to rein in domestic surveillance laws, with Sen. Wyden noting unprecedented support. Even the surveillance state occasionally faces pushback from people who actually read the Constitution.

articles.title: GitHub pulls pin on npm's auto-run scripts
articles.summary: Angry researcher drops new Windows 0-day in ongoing Microsoft beef. Nothing says 'responsible disclosure' like serving revenge code cold and public.

articles.title: CISA Adds Cisco, Chrome, and Arista Flaws to KEV Catalog Amid Active Exploitation
articles.summary: Unpatched Langflow AI platform flaw CVE-2026-5027 gets actively exploited for unauthenticated RCE. The AI revolution includes getting pwned by AI tools—how delightfully recursive.

articles.title: France’s ‘sovereign’ messenger Tchap was breached, and officials and the hacker disagree on how badly
articles.summary: France's 'sovereign' government messaging platform Tchap gets breached through basic account hijacking. Building your own secure messenger doesn't mean much if you forget the 'secure' part.

articles.title: Security in the Post-Mythos Era
articles.summary: Handala claims Israeli radar hack but researchers reveal it's just a phone admin panel access. When your l33t military infiltration turns out to be basic telecom pwnage—the digital equivalent of breaking into a janitor's closet.
